id: title:Gilbert09:compact delta tables when the vacuum fails

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse source maintenance behavior and failure handling
review.reason: The change adds a comment clarifying that warehouse vacuum and compaction are best-effort and do not stop on failure, while also adding an exception handler, a helper method, and a test case for vacuum failure. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in warehouse-source maintenance reliability and failure handling.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and test changes, but the actual runtime benefit and user impact are not independently verified; no adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No tier is assigned; this is an unassessed observation.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment and a sentence to the docstring, clarifying that vacuum and compaction are each best-effort and that a vacuum failure does not stop compaction.
